about: createPoller(...) driven through a script of steps — what it published, what it fetched, and what it persisted after each

cases.name: a first launch shows placeholders, then fetches each enabled provider in turn
cases.note: The emitted lists show the rail settling one provider at a time: refreshing flags clear in fetch order, and the numbers land together at the end.

cases.name: remembered readings show at once, dated and stale, until the first fetch lands
cases.note: A remembered unauthenticated reading is no reading: it starts as a placeholder.

cases.name: a rate limit shows the fallback, then holds back until the penalty ends
cases.note: Inside the penalty the provider is not asked at all; the dated numbers are shown instead.

cases.name: a penalty remembered from the last launch is waited out
a failed read keeps the last good numbers and dates them
a failure with nothing before it shows an error placeholder
an idle dock refreshes only once the idle interval has passed
cases.note: Refreshing while nobody is working only spends rate limit on numbers that cannot have moved.

cases.name: waking and coming back online refresh straight away
one provider refreshed on its own
cases.note: Refreshing a provider that is not enabled does nothing.

cases.name: toggling providers lands at once, without the network
a provider switched on mid-fetch is read by a follow-up refresh
cases.note: Landing the set from the start of the fetch instead would undo the toggle that happened in between. The follow-up refresh re-reads every enabled provider, not only the one switched on, so Claude is asked twice.

cases.name: a provider switched off mid-fetch is dropped
a placeholder added by a toggle is flagged on the next single refresh
cases.note: A placeholder starts with no refreshing flag at all, which is not the same as false: the single refresh writes false onto the new placeholder as it flags the one being read.

note: Providers answer from their scripted outcomes in order. `thenEnable` changes the enabled set while that fetch is in flight. Every step reports the lists emitted during it, the providers fetched, the final list, and the last backoff and snapshots saved. Providers are fetched in the order claude, codex, grok, cursor.
